name: PT Widodo Makmur Perkasa Tbk
summary: PT Widodo Makmur Perkasa Tbk operates in the consumer goods and agricultural commodities sector in Indonesia. The company operates through Cattles Farm, Feed, Poultry, Karkas, Meat and Processing Meat, Construction, and Trading and Other segments. It engages in the construction and energy, commodities, slaughter industry, chicken farm and animal feed trade, property, and leather processing industry. The company is also involved in soybean and rice trade, and general consultancy service business; and wholesale trade and cattle breeding, trade of meat and their products, chicken field, wholesale trade of agricultural food, and beverage products. PT Widodo Makmur Perkasa Tbk was founded in 2003…
